title: AAPS doesn't run on new BG latest dev-j
symptom: AAPS doesn't always run on new BG, causing the loop to run only every 10 minutes instead of 5. BG reading is received but the loop doesn't run. It happens sporadically, frequently many times a day.
cause: Data was backfilled from Nightscout due to old NS plugin.
fix: Switching to NS v3 new plugin solved the problem.
evidence_quote: Data actually was backfilled from NS due to old NS plugin. Switching to NS v3 new plugin solved the problem!
